definition: a doctor who provides general, ongoing care to you and your family
example: Many British Columbians still do not have a family doctor.

definition: a medical clinic where you can see a doctor without an appointment
vi: phòng khám không cần hẹn trước
example: I waited three hours at the walk-in clinic just to get a prescription renewed.

definition: to arrange a time to see a doctor or other professional
example: You can book an appointment online or by calling the clinic after 8 a.m.
collocations: book an appointment with a doctor

definition: a doctor's written order for medicine
example: The pharmacist said my prescription could be refilled two more times.

definition: a trained professional who prepares and sells medicines and gives advice
example: In BC, a pharmacist can now prescribe medication for some minor conditions.

definition: (of medicine) able to be bought without a prescription
example: For a mild headache, an over-the-counter painkiller is usually enough.

definition: signs of an illness that a person feels or notices
example: If your symptoms get worse after three days, see a doctor.

definition: unwanted effects of a medicine or treatment
example: Common side effects of this medication include drowsiness and dry mouth.

definition: insurance that pays for medical care
vi: bảo hiểm y tế, phạm vi chi trả y tế
example: New residents may have to wait up to three months before their provincial health coverage starts.

definition: a doctor's request sending a patient to see a specialist
vi: giấy giới thiệu (chuyển tuyến) đến bác sĩ chuyên khoa
example: You need a referral from your family doctor to see a dermatologist.

definition: a doctor with advanced training in one area of medicine
example: The wait to see a specialist in Vancouver can be several months.

definition: how long people must wait for a service, such as surgery
example: The province plans to hire more nurses to reduce emergency room wait times.

definition: the part of a hospital that treats urgent injuries and illnesses
example: We took my father to the emergency room when he had chest pain.

definition: a general medical examination to make sure you are healthy
example: I go to the dentist for a check-up and cleaning every six months.

definition: treatment of injuries using exercise, massage and movement
example: After my back injury, my extended benefits paid for ten sessions of physiotherapy.

definition: a person's emotional and psychological well-being
example: The company now offers free counselling to support employees' mental health.
collocations: take care of your mental health

definition: workplace insurance that covers costs not paid by the government, like dental or massage
vi: phúc lợi y tế bổ sung (bảo hiểm sức khỏe mở rộng)
example: My extended health benefits cover 80 percent of the cost of new glasses.

definition: to receive a vaccine to protect against a disease
example: Seniors are encouraged to get vaccinated against the flu every fall.

definition: (of an illness or problem) lasting a long time or keeping coming back
example: Many people with chronic back pain find relief through regular exercise.

definition: to become healthy again after an illness or injury
example: It took me nearly a month to recover from knee surgery.

definition: feeling slightly ill
example: I'm feeling a bit under the weather, so I'll work from home today.

definition: to injure a joint, like an ankle, by twisting it suddenly
example: She slipped on the icy sidewalk and sprained her ankle.

definition: having a bad physical reaction to a particular substance
example: Please tell the nurse if you are allergic to any medication.

definition: a later visit to check on progress after treatment
example: The doctor asked me to book a follow-up appointment in two weeks.

definition: a record of a person's past illnesses and treatments
example: New patients must fill out a form about their medical history.

definition: a way of living that includes good food, exercise and enough sleep
example: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle is easier when your workplace has a gym.

definition: extreme tiredness and stress caused by working too hard for too long
vi: kiệt sức (do làm việc quá sức)
example: Doctors warn that long shifts without breaks can lead to burnout among nurses.

definition: a short letter from a doctor confirming that someone was ill
vi: giấy xác nhận của bác sĩ (giấy nghỉ ốm)
example: My employer asked for a doctor's note after I missed a full week of work.

definition: a nurse with advanced training who can diagnose and prescribe
vi: y tá cấp cao (được chẩn đoán và kê đơn)
example: Patients without a family doctor can register with a nurse practitioner at the new clinic.

definition: a situation where there are not enough doctors
example: Small towns in northern BC have been hit hardest by the doctor shortage.
